title: a bare failed confirm is not catchable
purpose: The program terminates unsuccessfully after the observable effects listed.

failure.justification: spec 9.4 calls a bare failed confirm an uncatchable programming error while 11.4 says it panics (D-004); both categories are uncatchable.

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: spec 9.4: a bare failed confirm is an uncatchable programming error (spec 11.4 calls it a panic; D-004).
